SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS 
Hydration and Older Adults 
Older adults are at risk for dehydration because of diminished thirst and may cut back their fluid intake to avoid 
trips to the bathroom. Encouraging fluids can help mitigate poor fluid intake.
